changes: Productized Lattice Host Overflow: added CLI host status/dispatch aliases, bounded handoff pack and receipt submission paths, semantic host readiness, README/guide/decision docs, and host-overflow smoke coverage.
usage: Use lattice host_status --host=claude-code --json, lattice handoff_create --json --output=<pack>, lattice handoff_worktree_create --file=<pack> --json, lattice host_dispatch --host=claude-code --file=<pack> --mode=supervised --json, then lattice handoff_receipt_submit --file=<receipt> --json.
expectedOutcome: Claude Code can be planned as a supervised overflow host while Lattice keeps story, scope, receipt, and productionDone authority.
actualTranscript: Real-machine transcript recorded accepted-local receipt with scopeStatus=pass, freshness=fresh, pack/base/head/changedFiles validations pass, and receiptVerified=false/productionDone=false.
outcomeDiff: No behavioral gap: actual transcript matches the expected manual-first host overflow boundary.
limitations: Overflow dispatch is intentionally projection-only; external hosts cannot auto-merge, verify receipts, submit authoritative evidence, or claim productionDone.
pitfalls: Receipt proof needs a current-base local headSha diff; stale or unrelated commits correctly downgrade to diagnostic instead of accepted-local.
